title: Tolerability Study of Trichostatin A In Subjects With Relapsed or Refractory Hematologic Malignancies
official: Tolerability Study of Trichostatin A In Subjects With Relapsed or Refractory Hematologic Malignancies
summary: The aim of this study is to investigate the safety and tolerability of trichostatin A in individuals with relapsed or refractory hematologic malignancies.
